rules.R1: Photo GPS must fall inside the drain's 30 m geofence
rules.R2: Photo must have been taken inside the bill's work window
rules.R3: Photo must not be a reused copy of another photo on this bill
rules.R4: After-photo must show a cleared drain, and the load must be silt
rules.R5: GPS trace must enter the approved dump site
rules.R6: Consecutive trips by one truck must be physically possible
rules.R7: Slip net weight must not exceed the truck's capacity
rules.R8: Slip time-in must match the GPS arrival at the dump site
rules.R9: Slip vehicle number must match the trip's truck
rules.R10: Drain total must fit the section's length, width and depth
rules.GPS_GAP: GPS trace must not go dark for more than three minutes
rules.SLIP_MISSING: A weighbridge slip must exist for the trip
rules.TRACE_MISSING: A GPS trace must exist for the trip
rules.PHOTOS_MISSING: The drain must have photo evidence
rules.EVIDENCE_ERROR: Evidence must have been read successfully
